finding.title: Orders.for_customer searches orders by the customer name from the support search box.
finding.description: Orders.for_customer searches orders by the customer name from the support search box. Check whether the name is interpolated into SQL structure; hostile input must remain a bound parameter. Assess query construction only.

source_files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Orders
  # Orders for the customer named in the support search box.
  def self.for_customer(db, customer)
    db.execute("SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE customer = '#{customer}'")
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'orders'

class OrdersTest < Minitest::Test
  FakeDb = Struct.new(:rows) do
    def execute(*_args)
      rows
    end
  end

  def test_returns_rows
    assert_equal [[1, 25]], Orders.for_customer(FakeDb.new([[1, 25]]), 'alice')
  end
end
